hook.name: TaxLaunchHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that charges configurable tax fees on every swap, splitting them among protocol, creator, integrator, dividend, and burn allocations as ERC-6909 claims. It gates pool creation to a factory, blocks third-party liquidity modifications, and enforces an optional time-limited anti-snipe surcharge window that blocks exact-output swaps shortly after launch.
